summary.text: Brian Beckley is the Republican candidate for the Idaho House of Representatives, District 8B, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Jared Dawson.
Beckley is a business executive who chairs the Idaho Department of Parks and Recreation board, according to his Ballotpedia survey.

paragraphs.text: Brian Beckley graduated from Madison Senior High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Phoenix; his profession is listed as business executive.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a sixth-generation Idahoan from Hibbard who lives in Hammett with his wife, Traci, and works the family ranch and runs businesses.
He said Governor Brad Little appointed him chair of the Idaho Department of Parks and Recreation board.

Beckley said his priorities include wildfire prevention and forest health, returning decisions on public lands, forests and water to local residents, lowering taxes and reducing spending, and defending Idaho's water.
